items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: if they’re playing a piece by Schoenberg or something I’m going to say, “I don’t get it.”

ctx.x: Yes. My grandfather said to me once, you know, “I worry about you playing this jazz music” you know, “there are drugs and alcohol” and you know, “why don’t you get a job like in a symphony or something?” And I told him that this is the music I really love. And they were both very broad-minded and the fact that it was music, even though they didn’t get it, it was music and I was obviously serious. Whenever I was there I would be practicing a lot, it was a great place to practice. And so they knew I was serious and…
I think the term “get it” is very interesting because I could respect what they’re doing but if they’re playing a piece by Schoenberg or something I’m going to say, “I don’t get it.”
